|translation='''Title:''' Imperial Walker.

'''Card text:'''
May carry one pilot and eight passengers. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:'''
Four-legged enclosed combat vehicle. The looming AT-AT (All Terrain Armored Transport) can carry an entire battalion of fully armed soldiers.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says battalion where the English lore says squadron.
